Visibility is an explicitly simulated document input while Chromium remains able to paint; it is not physical Electron occlusion.
Zero draw claims use actual WebGL renderer counters, not browser-wide paint or frame timing.
Manual clock cases establish behavior, not performance or hardware-floor acceptance.
